en.text: Yun Seorin handled records on registration duty in the main building of Government Complex Seoul at 209 Sejong-daero, Jongno-gu. Forging records is forbidden. Without the government seal, downtown water contracts have no force. Yun Seorin became president after keeping the seal box of the Bukhansan Bogukmun Records House in unbroken custody. The seal box of the Seoul Station Record-Law House belongs to Yeorian. In 2126 the civilian administration handles Jongno and Jung-gu resident rolls, distribution, and ratification at Cheong Wa Dae, while the Government Complex Seoul guards protect downtown stations. If he holds up Han Jaemok's western plan, debt accumulates; if he stamps it, Yangcheon's veto dies.
Rank: President. Office: President of the Republic of Korea Livelihood byname: Record Bureau chief (separate from the presidency).
When the three testaments were received, Yun Seorin suspended ratification and checked only the seal of the box.
Bukhansan Bogukmun Records House (HC05). Steward. Yeorian is steward of the Seoul Station Record-Law House (HP04).
A ratification dispute with Han Jaemok, a ration-ledger exchange with Nam Yungyeong, and a ratification rivalry with Jeong Yura.

en.text: She guards the founding-ratification case entrusted by Yun Seorin, matches humidity and custody cycles with Jo Harin's iron case, and brings out Jeong Yura's joint-negotiation ratification only without falsifying its date.

ko.text: 윤서린이 맡긴 건국 인준 함을 지키고, 조하린의 철제 함 습도와 보관 주기를 맞추며, 정유라의 공동교섭 인준은 날짜를 속이지 않는 한에서만 꺼낸다.

en.text: She aims to keep the polities' original ratifications valid only in the Seoul Station case, preventing government ratification from being sold as an after-the-fact stamp.

en.text: He objects to Yun Seorin's custody of the merit roll, hopes his office and title will not become merchandise at Ma Eungyeol's copy auction, and seeks to register his name again at Seol Dahuin's concourse desk.

ko.text: 윤서린의 공신록 보관에 이의를 남기고, 마은결의 사본 경매에서 자신의 관작이 물건이 되지 않기를 바라며, 설다흰의 대합실 창구에 이름을 다시 올리려 한다.
